item.title: 'LOTS OF WINNING!!!' Trump praises America's historic hockey victory at Winter Olympics
item.description: President Donald Trump showered the United States men's hockey team with praise Sunday for its historic victory at the 2026 Winter Olympic Games.The men's hockey team took home the gold for the first time in 46 years after Jack Hughes scored the winning goal over Canada in overtime.
